process.title: Room list, then a set on a bed.

steps.description: On a bed. Logo on the actual towel. About 12 days.

steps.title: Sign, then make
steps.description: Stitch, finish, set completeness on the line.

steps.title: Count and ship
steps.description: Set count, packing list, certificates in the carton.

warranty.title: When a set, wash or logo misses the signed sample.
warranty.description: The signed set and the lot number are the reference — not the quote towel.
warranty.commitment: Claims follow the signed set, the certificate and the packing list in the carton.

cases.question: If towels go limp after industrial wash
cases.title: GSM and loop density checked on a washed sample first.
cases.description: Feel is locked after wash, not on the unwashed quote piece.

cases.question: If the certificate does not match the lot
cases.title: Hold the PO until the scope file is attached.
cases.description: Certified cartons only take certified pieces.

cases.question: If embroidery misses the artwork
cases.title: Proof first, then the heads.
cases.description: Off-spec pieces are pulled before packing.

cases.question: If a set is incomplete
cases.title: The packing list is the count.
cases.description: Each set is counted at final audit.
